scope: Early startup isolation only; no firmware, full-board or clock-phase qualification
interpretation: Fixed analog driver controls complete 150 us without bridges, with ADC observers, and with ADC observers plus constant known-low DAC inputs. Replaying captured digital events through the same DACs with out_undef=0 aborts at 102.86290624677614 us without CPU/firmware execution. The event timestamps originated from a different unknown-output mapping; this is an isolation experiment, not an exact replay of live zero-unknown startup. It narrows the failure to circuit/event behavior without establishing a simulator defect. The no-bridge clock peak remains below the 2 V high-level requirement in this early window.
